data.title: Immutable Holdings and Jorge Masvidal's Gamebred Fighting Championship (FC) Enter Into Definitive Agreement for Proposed Reverse Takeover Transaction and Listing on the TSXV
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / October 9, 2026 / Immutable Holdings Inc. (CBOE:HOLD)(OTCQB:IHLDF) ("Immutable" or the "Corporation") is pleased to announce that it has entered into an acquisition agreement (the "Definitive Agreement") with Gamebred FC, LLC. ("Gamebred"), which outlines the terms and conditions pursuant to which the parties will complete an arm's length transaction that will result in the reverse take-over of Immutable by Gamebred (the "Proposed Transaction") to ultimately form the resulting issuer (the "Resulting Issuer"). It is intended that the Proposed Transaction will constitute a "reverse take-over" of Immutable under the policies of CBOE Canada ("Cboe") and following completion of the Proposed Transaction, the Resulting Issuer will carry on the business currently carried on by Gamebred. It is also intended that Immutable will delist its subordinate voting shares from Cboe and the Resulting Issuer will obtain a listing on the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), subject to receipt of all required regulatory approvals.

Proposed Transaction Summary

Pursuant to the terms of the Definitive Agreement, the Proposed Transaction will be effected through a three-cornered merger (the "Merger") involving a newly incorporated Florida subsidiary of Immutable ("Newco"), whereby Newco will merge with and into Gamebred under the Florida Business Corporation Act, with Gamebred surviving the merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Immutable. Following completion of the Proposed Transaction, Immutable is expected to continue as the Resulting Issuer and carry on the business currently conducted by Gamebred.

There are currently an aggregate of 32,583,077 subordinate voting shares of Immutable ("SV Shares") and 65,508 multiple voting shares of Immutable ("MV Shares" and together with the SV Shares, the "Immutable Shares") issued and outstanding, as well as 4,166,100 stock options of Immutable. As a result of the Merger, the holders of the issued and outstanding shares of Gamebred ("Gamebred Shares") will receive shares of the Resulting Issuer ("Resulting Issuer Shares") in exchange for their Gamebred Shares. The aggregate consideration payable to holders of Gamebred Shares will consist of 312,500,000 Resulting Issuer Shares, subject to adjustments, with the exact number of Resulting Issuer Shares issuable per Gamebred Share determined by dividing 312,500,000 by the number of Gamebred Shares issued and outstanding on a fully diluted basis immediately prior to closing, excluding securities issued pursuant to the Concurrent Financing (as defined below) (the "Share Exchange Ratio").

Based on the number of Immutable Shares currently outstanding and the issuance of 312,500,000 Resulting Issuer Shares to the holders of Gamebred Shares pursuant to the Proposed Transaction, existing shareholders of Immutable are expected to hold approximately 23.9% of the Resulting Issuer Shares and former shareholders of Gamebred are expected to hold approximately 76.1% of the Resulting Issuer Shares immediately following completion of the Proposed Transaction, in each case prior to giving effect to the Concurrent Financing and subject to any adjustments contemplated by the Definitive Agreement. Accordingly, the foregoing ownership percentages are estimates and may change prior to closing.

At closing, all outstanding Gamebred Shares will be exchanged for Resulting Issuer Shares. Outstanding stock options of Immutable will remain outstanding following closing with no change to their existing terms.

In connection with the Proposed Transaction, Immutable intends to change its name to a name designated by Gamebred, subject to regulatory approval and the completion of all required corporate procedures.

Bridge Loan

In connection with the execution of the Definitive Agreement, the Corporation advanced a bridge loan in the principal amount of US$1,000,000 to Gamebred pursuant to the terms of a secured promissory note entered into between the Corporation and Gamebred (the "Bridge Loan"). The Bridge Loan is secured by a general security agreement granting a security interest in all of the personal property, assets and undertakings of Gamebred, as well as unlimited joint and several personal guarantees from the principal shareholders of Gamebred. The Bridge Loan bears interest at a rate of equal to Daily Simple SOFR plus 6.0% per annum, calculated daily. The Bridge Loan matures on December 31, 2026.

Gamebred intends to use the proceeds of the Bridge Loan to fund working capital and general business purposes of Gamebred.

Concurrent Financing

Prior to or concurrently with completion of the Proposed Transaction, Immutable or Gamebred (or one of its affiliates) is expected to complete an equity financing (the "Concurrent Financing") in such form, with such terms and for such amount as may be agreed by the parties and as may be required to satisfy the listing requirements of the TSXV. Completion of the Concurrent Financing is a condition to completion of the Proposed Transaction.

Senior Management and Board of Directors

Upon completion of the Proposed Transaction, it is anticipated that management of the Resulting Issuer will include solely representatives of Gamebred. In addition, subject to approval by the TSXV, the board of directors of the Resulting Issuer, at the time of closing, is expected to consist of five directors, one of whom will be selected by Immutable and four of whom will be selected by Gamebred.

Conditions of Completion

Completion of the Proposed Transaction is subject to satisfaction or waiver of a number of conditions, including Gamebred's conversion to a Florida Corporation, and other conditions customary for a transaction of this nature, including, among other things:

  • receipt of conditional approval from the TSXV for the listing of the Resulting Issuer Shares following the delisting of the Immutable Shares from Cboe;
  • completion of the Concurrent Financing; and
  • receipt of all required corporate, regulatory and third-party approvals.

The Proposed Transaction remains subject to review and approval by Cboe under its applicable policies. In addition, the listing of the Resulting Issuer Shares on the TSXV and the delisting of the Immutable Shares from Cboe are subject to review and approval by the TSXV and Cboe, respectively.

Trading in Immutable Shares

Trading in the Immutable Shares will be halted in compliance with the policies of Cboe. Trading in the Immutable Shares is expected to remain halted pending completion of the Proposed Transaction. In connection with the Proposed Transaction, Immutable intends to delist the Immutable Shares from Cboe and seek a listing of the Resulting Issuer Shares on the TSXV. Subject to completion of the Proposed Transaction and satisfaction of all applicable listing requirements, the Resulting Issuer Shares are expected to commence trading on the TSXV following closing.

Additional Information

Further updates in respect of the Proposed Transaction will be provided in a subsequent news release.

Additional information concerning the Proposed Transaction, Immutable, Gamebred and the Resulting Issuer will also be provided in subsequent filings to be made by Immutable and Gamebred in connection with the Proposed Transaction, which will be available under the Immutable's SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca.

About Gamebred

Gamebred is a combat sports promotion and media company focused on the production and promotion of professional bare-knuckle mixed martial arts events. Founded by UFC legend Jorge Masvidal, Gamebred's events combine bare-knuckle fighting with the Unified Rules of Mixed Martial Arts, allowing competitors to utilize striking, grappling and submission techniques without gloves. Through live events, media rights, sponsorships and related commercial initiatives, Gamebred seeks to capitalize on the growing global demand for combat sports entertainment. Gamebred recently entered into a global media rights partnership with DAZN, expanding the international reach of its content and events.

About Immutable

Immutable is a collection of businesses within the digital assets ecosystem on a mission to build businesses and products that increase the awareness, access, and adoption of digital assets. Founded by Jordan Fried, a member of the founding team of the Hedera Hashgraph network, the Corporation has launched and operated business ventures in several verticals, across asset management, NFTs, media, and education. This has included Immutable Asset Management, NFT.com, Immutable Media, 1-800-Bitcoin, and HBAR Labs. The Corporation's approach has been to evaluate market opportunities as they arise and to build businesses that can support the growth of the digital asset ecosystem. For further information regarding Immutable Holdings, visit https://immutableholdings.com/ and see the Corporation's disclosure documents on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

For media inquiries and further information, contact:

Billy Baxter, Interim CFO and Head of Corporate Development & Operations
Email: info@immutableholdings.com

data.title: Tidal Wave Auto Spa Expands in Oklahoma and Texas with Two Grand Openings This Week
data.description:
THOMASTON, GA / ACCESS Newswire / October 9, 2026 / Tidal Wave Auto Spa®, one of the nation's fastest-growing conveyor car wash companies, is pleased to announce the grand openings of two new locations this week in Claremore, Oklahoma and El Paso, Texas. The new locations mark the company's 6th location in Oklahoma and 23rd in Texas, bringing the total Tidal Wave network to 335 locations across 30 states.

To celebrate the Grand Openings, both locations are offering 12 days of free premium car washes from October 7 to October 18. This limited-time promotion lets customers experience the company's premium wash option, Graph-X4® + Super Shammy, at no cost. Both locations feature mat cleaning stations, complimentary tire air, spot-free rinse, undercarriage wash, foam and wax treatments, and tire shine - delivering a complete car care experience from start to finish. Tidal Wave is also extending its popular Founders Club offer through both Grand Opening celebrations (October 7-18) - available on the top 3 wash plans, new members pay just $10 for their first month, then receive $10 off each month for the following 12 months, for 13 months of savings. New Tidal Wave members gain access to the entire 335-location network spanning 30 states, offering unmatched convenience for customers on the go.

"Opening in both Claremore and El Paso in the same week is a great reflection of where Tidal Wave is right now - we're growing into new markets and deepening our presence in others," said Tidal Wave Auto Spa CEO and Founder, Scott Blackstock. "Claremore is a community with a strong identity and loyal roots, and El Paso is a city that has embraced us in a big way - this second location there is a direct response to that. We're proud to bring the Tidal Wave experience to both communities and give back through our Giveback Days in Claremore and El Paso."

Tidal Wave is proud to invest in the communities it calls home, having donated more than $8 million to charitable organizations nationwide. In celebration of the Claremore grand opening, the company will host Giveback Day on Wednesday, October 14, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., donating $1 for every free wash and $5 for every new Tidal Wave Clean Club membership to Roosa Elementary School. Donations will support Roosa Elementary's commitment to academic excellence and STEM education, one of the few schools in Oklahoma to consistently earn recognition as a Great Expectations Model School.

In celebration of the El Paso grand opening, the company will host Giveback Day on Thursday, October 15, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., donating $1 for every free wash and $5 for every new Tidal Wave Clean Club membership to The ARC El Paso. Donations will support The ARC El Paso's mission to ensure people with intellectual and developmental disabilities are included in their communities, with access to the support, resources, and opportunities they need to lead fulfilling lives.

Claremore, OK Address: 1701 Scissortail Ave, Claremore, OK 74017

El Paso, TX Address: 1458 Lee Trevino Drive, El Paso, TX 79936

Nearby Location (El Paso): 2080 N Zaragoza Rd, El Paso, TX

Tidal Wave proudly serves customers at 335 conveyor car wash locations across the United States, including 6 in Oklahoma and 23 in Texas, with additional openings planned this year in Albuquerque, NM and Merritt Island, FL.

Tidal Wave Auto Spa is committed to providing every customer with an exceptional car wash experience through industry-leading car care technology, clean and welcoming locations, and friendly customer service. With single wash options starting at $15, unlimited wash memberships and family plans, and fleet plans for businesses, Tidal Wave delivers solutions to fit every need.

For additional information about Tidal Wave Auto Spa, please visit tidalwaveautospa.com.

About Tidal Wave Auto Spa

Tidal Wave Auto Spa was founded in 1999 in Thomaston, GA, by husband and wife Scott and Hope Blackstock. What started as a small-town self-service car wash business evolved into the first conveyor car wash open in Georgia and is now the fifth-largest conveyor car wash company in the nation, with 335 locations spanning 30 states. Tidal Wave is dedicated to delivering an exceptional car wash experience for every customer through industry-leading car care technology, clean and inviting locations, and outstanding customer service. The company is equally committed to making a positive difference in the communities it serves, raising over $8 million through its year-round fundraising initiatives and annual Charity Day event.

Media Contact: media@tidalwaveautospa.com

Website: tidalwaveautospa.com

data.title: MEGAN FOX BECOMES CO-OWNER OF SUBS.COM AND LAUNCHES OFFICIAL PAGE
data.description:
MEGAN FOX BECOMES CO-OWNER OF SUBS.COM AND LAUNCHES OFFICIAL PAGE

MEGAN FOX BECOMES CO-OWNER OF SUBS.COM AND LAUNCHES OFFICIAL PAGE

PR Newswire

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 9, 2026

Fox takes an ownership stake in the direct-to-fan platform as she opens a new, exclusive channel to fans — entirely on her terms.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Megan Fox isn't just joining another platform. She owns part of it. With more celebrities set to join in the coming months. 

The actress and entrepreneur today announced that she has become a co-owner of Subs.com, a direct-to-fan platform, with her official page launching today. 

For more than two decades, audiences have seen Fox through movie screens, magazine covers, interviews and social media. Subs.com gives them something different: a direct connection to Fox in a space where she decides what gets shared. 

Fox joins Subs.com with a seat at the table as the company grows. Her official page puts that idea into practice, featuring exclusive content chosen by Fox and shared directly with her subscribers. Fox became globally famous before the creator economy gave public figures the ability to build direct relationships with millions of people on their own terms. Subs.com is built around the next step: giving talent and celebrities the ability to build a business around content they create for their audience.

"Women have spent decades being told that visibility is power while someone else owns the platform, the audience or the image," Fox said. "I'm interested in what happens when women own all three." 

For Fox, that means being more than the face of the partnership. 

"Megan understands this shift from a perspective very few people can," said Subs.com cofounder Tim Stokely. "She became globally famous before talent had the tools to own their audiences or control their distribution. Megan isn't simply launching a page on Subs — she has a seat at the table and is helping us build the platform." 

Fox's official Subs.com page is now live, giving fans a new way to connect with her and see what she chooses to share when she is the one in control. 

See what Megan Fox is sharing on her official Subs.com page: subs.com/meganfox

About Megan Fox

Megan Fox is an actress and entrepreneur whose career spans more than two decades across film and television. Her credits include Transformers, Jennifer's Body and New Girl. 

About Subs.com

Subs.com is a direct-to-fan creator platform co-founded by Tim Stokely (the co-founder of OnlyFans.com). Building on their experience creating one of the world's most recognized direct-to-fan platforms, Stokely launched Subs.com to give established talent greater ownership and control over their content, audience and fan relationships.

Subs.com enables celebrities and public figures across film, sport, and music, to connect directly with their communities through exclusive content and experiences.

SOURCE Subs.com

data.title: Preview — Barron's
data.description:
Monday 10/12

Fixed-income markets are closed in observance of Columbus Day.

Tuesday 10/13

Third-quarter earnings season commences, with financials leading the way. Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs Group, and Wells Fargo release quarterly results on Tuesday, followed by Bank of America, BlackRock, and Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, and Charles Schwab and Interactive Brokers Group on Thursday. Outside of financials, Johnson & Johnson and UnitedHealth Group announce earnings on Tuesday.

Wednesday 10/14

The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the consumer price index for September. Consensus estimate is for a 3.6% year-over-year increase, two-tenths of a percentage point more than in August. The core CPI is expected to rise 2.5% from 2.4% previously.

Thursday 10/15

The Census Bureau reports retail sales data for September. Economists forecast a 0.3% month-over-month gain, after a 1.1% jump in August. Excluding autos and gas, sales are seen rising 0.2%.

data.description:
Limestone Custom Homes: New Colorado ADU Law Makes 2026-2027 the Right Time for Douglas County Homeowners to Build an Accessory Dwelling Unit

Limestone Custom Homes: New Colorado ADU Law Makes 2026-2027 the Right Time for Douglas County Homeowners to Build an Accessory Dwelling Unit

PR Newswire

CASTLE ROCK, Colo., Oct. 9, 2026

State law HB24-1152 removes long-standing barriers for homeowners in Castle Rock, Parker, Highlands Ranch, and Lone Tree

CASTLE ROCK, Colo., Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Limestone Custom Homes, a Castle Rock-based design-build custom home company, today said the 2026-2027 building season is shaping up as the most favorable window in recent memory for Douglas County homeowners to build an accessory dwelling unit (ADU). Colorado's HB24-1152, which took effect June 30, 2025, now requires communities including Castle Rock, Parker, Lone Tree, and unincorporated Douglas County to allow one ADU on single-family lots through an administrative approval process, replacing a patchwork of local rules that discouraged many homeowners from moving forward.

Under the new law, qualifying jurisdictions can no longer require additional off-street parking for an ADU in most cases, impose owner-occupancy requirements, or apply stricter design standards to an ADU than to the main home. The law also voids HOA covenants that prohibit ADUs outright, a significant change in HOA-heavy Douglas County, though associations may still apply reasonable design standards.

According to Limestone Custom Homes, Douglas County homeowners pursuing ADUs are typically motivated by a few consistent goals: housing for aging parents or adult children, long-term rental income to offset rising housing costs, home offices and studios, and guest suites. Many plan for more than one, designing a unit for a family member today that can become a rental later.

"Douglas County homeowners have wanted to build ADUs for years. The demand was always there, and the process was the obstacle," a Limestone Custom Homes spokesperson said. "With administrative approval now the standard, homeowners who had shelved ADU plans are taking a second look. Whether it's a detached backyard cottage, a garage conversion, or a finished basement with a separate entrance, the path is much clearer than it was two years ago."

As an ADU builder in Colorado, Limestone designs and builds accessory dwelling units throughout Douglas County and the Denver metro area, managing architecture, permitting, construction, and finish selections with one in-house team from its Castle Rock office.

About Limestone Custom Homes

Limestone Custom Homes is one of Colorado's leading design-build custom home companies, with offices in Castle Rock and projects across Douglas County, the Denver metro area, the Colorado mountains, and Larimer County. The company specializes in high-end custom homes and ADUs with a fully in-house design, architecture, and construction team. For more information, visit Limestone Custom Homes.

Microvast Investigation Continued: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Continues to Investigate the Officers and Directors of Microvast Holdings, Inc. - MVST

PR Newswire

NEW YORK and NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 9, 2026

NEW YORK and NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Former Attorney General of Louisiana, Charles C. Foti, Jr., Esq., a partner at the law firm of Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC ("KSF"), announces that KSF has continued its investigation into Microvast Holdings, Inc. (NasdaqCM: MVST).

On November 21, 2023, J Capital Research published a report entitled "MVST: Empty Facilities and a Grant Loss That Was Probably Hidden: Another China Hustle" alleging that the Company knew that a proposed $200 million U.S. Department of Energy Grant to help fund a proposed polyaramid separator production facility had been rescinded for months prior to a May 2023 Reuters report, but failed to inform investors. The report further alleged that "the majority of MVST's sales may be fake"; that "Chinese customers account for 57% of revenue in 2023" but drone footage showed the Company's Chinese factory "shows almost no activity"; that the Company "has disappeared from Chinese procurement lists" and "local competitors say the company is not making discernible sales," and that the Company's reported backlog was "dubious."

Thereafter, the Company and certain of its executives were sued in a securities class action lawsuit, charging them with failing to disclose material information in violation of federal securities laws. The court presiding over that case has denied the Company's motion to dismiss in part, allowing the case to move forward. 

KSF's investigation is focusing on whether Microvast's officers and/or directors breached their fiduciary duties to its shareholders or otherwise violated state or federal laws.

data.title: Catholic Charities USA launches relief fund for those impacted by Hurricane Isaias
data.description:
Catholic Charities USA launches relief fund for those impacted by Hurricane Isaias

Catholic Charities USA launches relief fund for those impacted by Hurricane Isaias

PR Newswire

ALEXANDRIA, Va., Oct. 9, 2026

ALEXANDRIA, Va., Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As forecasters warn that Hurricane Isaias will bring devastating winds and dangerous storm surges to the Gulf Coast, Catholic Charities USA (CCUSA), the official domestic relief agency of the Catholic Church in the United States, has launched a dedicated disaster relief donation campaign (ccusa.online/isaias). One hundred percent of all funds raised will be allocated to local Catholic Charities agencies, which will provide critical relief — including shelter, food and other humanitarian aid — to displaced and suffering members of their communities.

"Our sisters and brothers along the Gulf Coast need our prayers and support as this powerful storm threatens their communities," CCUSA President and CEO Kerry Alys Robinson said. "The staff and volunteers of local Catholic Charities agencies throughout the region will be there to bring comfort and hope to their neighbors in need. Please join us in providing critical aid to the immediate and long-term relief efforts."

CCUSA and its member agencies around the country have a long history of rapidly mobilizing following disasters not only to meet the immediate needs but also to provide critical, long-term support to communities as they rebuild. Every year, thanks to the generosity of thousands of concerned donors, the Catholic Charities network responds to roughly 60 disasters, from hurricanes and tornadoes to fires and floods. 

To support those impacted by Hurricane Isaias, please make a gift today.

About Catholic Charities USA    

Founded in 1910, CCUSA is a national membership organization that supports and represents 170 Catholic Charities agencies across the United States and in five territories. Collectively, the Catholic Charities network each year serves more than 16 million vulnerable people, regardless of their faith or background, through food and nutrition programs, affordable housing, disaster relief and a variety of other humanitarian services. To learn more about CCUSA, please visit our website at CatholicCharitiesUSA.org or contact Kevin Brennan, Vice President for Communications, at media@catholiccharitiesusa.org.

data.title: 'I have no children': My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
data.description:
By Quentin Fottrell

'The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.'

"I've always planned for whatever I leave to go to my brother, a dear friend and a couple of charities I care about." (Photo subject is a model.)

Dear Quentin,

Eleven years ago, my aunt gave me $50,000 toward my house, and I'm still grateful. I was 44, newly divorced and buying my first home on my own. I had about $65,000 saved but was short on the down payment for a three-bedroom in a neighborhood I liked. My aunt had money in a savings account earning next to nothing, and she said she'd rather see it go toward a home. She called it a gift and never asked me to sign anything.

The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close. Since then I've put in about $90,000 more: a new roof, kitchen appliances, plumbing work and new windows. The house is worth around $650,000 now, though that isn't cash in my pocket, and I still owe about $180,000. My aunt is 78 and has two adult children, a son,52, and a daughter, 49.

I barely know them. We see each other at Thanksgiving and Christmas; I send cards and birthday texts, and that's about it. My aunt has been a big part of my life. She helped me through the divorce, sat with me when my father was dying and stayed with me for a week after my surgery a few years ago. She has never held the $50,000 over me until now. At dinner last month, she asked me to change my will so the house goes to her two children when I die.

She said it isn't unreasonable and wanted me to consider her offer. She doesn't need the money herself. She just wants her kids to eventually benefit from what she gave me. I told her I'd always understood the money as a gift to me, not an investment in the house or an early inheritance for her children. She had a poker face, but I could tell she did not like my response. I don't want to punish her for being generous. But I'm not comfortable with that request.

I don't want to leave a house worth hundreds of thousands of dollars to two people I barely know. I have no children, and I've always planned for whatever I leave to go to my brother, a dear friend and a couple of charities I care about. I haven't thought of the house as a bargaining chip, just as the biggest thing I own. My aunt says I'm being too literal and that family isn't supposed to keep score. Now I feel gaslighted!

Am I being selfish for refusing to leave the house, or a good part of it, to my aunt's children?

Grateful Homeowner

Related: After 46 years working, I'm not retiring - instead, I take a vacation every month. Is that a good life in your 70s?

You can email The Moneyist with any financial and ethical questions at qfottrell@marketwatch.com. The Moneyist regrets he cannot reply to questions individually.

The $50,000 was a gift, not a loan.

Dear Homeowner,

You are not being selfish. You have agency over your own life and finances. You are not being gaslighted. You are feeling pressured.

The $50,000 was a gift, not a loan and that, to split hairs, is being used as the bargaining chip. You can acknowledge that without agreeing to change your will. If you want to offer something, a modest bequest to her children is a proportionate option. Your aunt may not have meant to have come across so aggressively. Sometimes, people can feel embarrassed in the moment.

If you are uncomfortable about leaving her children any money, don't do it. It's far better to be uncomfortable with your aunt's request and her response to your answer than it is to be uncomfortable with giving money to people you barely know. It's your house - and you can leave it to whom you want to.

What now? Let's assume that $50,000 would be worth $216,000 in 30 years with compounding. You could leave each of her children $108,000, which is more than generous, and reimburses them for the money your aunt gave you out, with interest, assuming that the down payment reduced their inheritance. That's a suggestion, not a request.

You have poured $90,000 into this home to renovate, which has added value; you have worked hard over the last 11 years to pay off the principal and the interest; and you have taken pride in knowing that you have created a home that you can be proud of. Millions of housebuyers get help with a down payment, although it varies by generation.

Homebuyers frequently receive financial help

Four in 10 homeowners received financial help with a down payment on their current home, including nearly 80% of Generation Z homeowners, 56% of millennials and 35% of Generation X (which happens to be your cohort), according to a recent LendingTree survey. The percentage was much lower (12%) for baby boomers.

However, arguably it was easier to buy a house 30 years ago, as the price-to-income ratio has narrowed significantly. Depending on the study, the typical home costs up to seven times the median annual salary today versus just four times the median annual salary 30 years ago. That would explain why fewer baby boomers needed a leg up from parents/family members.

Your aunt definitely overstepped the mark.

Your aunt, for better or for worse, bided her time. You are now in your 50s and never had children of your own, and she has your home in her crosshairs. Yes, she has been a kind and supportive aunt, attending your graduation and helping you get your foot on the property ladder. In many ways, she has been like another mother to you.

If she were your mother, I could see a similar scenario playing out where she would suggest that you support the family cause and leave your house to your brother. But you have no children, and you have already decided to remember your brother in your will, and yet your aunt decided to proffer a version of that request. As an aunt, it doesn't quite land in the same way.

Children often ask the same of their parents

Lest we forget, these pages are rife with adult children, grandchildren, nieces and nephews making similar requests of their elders, asking what will happen to their estate after they're gone, and giving helpful suggestions about what should happen to the estate - which, surprise, surprise! - always seem to favor the one asking the question.

Asking the question is certainly a brazen, if not entirely unusual, state of affairs in families, especially if she considers herself a de facto guardian. However, she definitely overstepped the mark by indicating that leaving the home to her two adult children is the "decent" thing to do. That's a lot more prescriptive than just asking a question.

You don't have to feel ashamed about accepting her gift. Without your aunt's gift, you may never have been able to buy a home or it would have taken you many years. Yes, you are one of the millions of homebuyers receive assistance in the form of a down payment, mortgage payments and/or acting as a guarantor - so her generosity means you are not alone

What do you tell your aunt? You can tell her that you appreciate her help with the down payment, and you will give some thought, but that your estate plans are private. You don't have to answer to anyone. If she persists, you may wish to make it clear that being single and without children does not mean that you have to abide by other people's wishes.

Ultimately, it was a gift, and you can do what you want.
